ollamaUrl.description: Base URL for the Ollama API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434).

pollMs.description: Interval in milliseconds between GPU snapshot polls.

externalClaimThresholdMb.description: VRAM usage threshold (MB) above which external pressure triggers a ghost-claim.

defaultHoldMs.description: Default lease hold duration in milliseconds before auto-expiry.

dormant.description: When true the broker skips all polling and permits all agent runs.
